chunks: Muhammad b. Musa b. al-Mutawakkil (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Abi Abdillah al-Kufi narrated to us. He said: Musa b. Imran al-Nakha'i narrated to us from his uncle al-Husayn b. Yazid al-Nawfali from Ali b. Salim from his father from Thabit b. Abi Safiyya from Sa'id b. Jubayr from Ibn Abbas. He said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) said:
Whoever would be gladdened by Allah gathering all goodness for him should align with Ali after me, and align with his supporters, and oppose his enemies.
ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about aligning with Ali after him to gather all goodness?
ai.summary: This hadith from Ibn Abbas records the Prophet's (s) declaration that alignment with Ali (a) after his passing is the key to all goodness. By tying loyalty to Ali with the comprehensive gathering of all good (al-khayr kullahu), the Prophet establishes that love and support for Ali is not merely a political stance but a spiritual imperative closely connected to one's ultimate felicity. The instruction to also support Ali's allies and oppose his enemies extends this principle into a broader framework of loyalty.
